Name: Halloween Hats and Treats
Author: Sh1ryUwu
Description:
[b][size=3]Mod adds 8 new hats that can be bought from hat mouse and [/size][b][size=3]also adds 6 unique candys that can be craft on kitchen.[/size]
[/b][size=4]Hats:[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][b]Cursed Monocle[/b]
[*][b]Moon Mask[/b]
[*][b]Scarecrow Hat[/b]
[*][b]Elite Scarecrow Hat[/b]
[*][b]Old Scarecrow Mask[/b]
[*][b]Pumpkin Hairpin[/b]
[*][b]Spider Hairpin[/b]
[*][b]Joja Hairpin[/b]
[/list][b][size=4]Candies:[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][b]Spring Taffy[/b]
[*][b]Summer Sweets[/b]
[*][b]Autumn Caramels[/b]
[*][b]Winter Mints[/b]
[*][b]Royal Candy[/b]
[*][b]Joja Candy[/b]
[/list][b][size=4]Candys Recipe Locations:[/size][/b][list]
[*][b]Seasonal candy recipes can be purchased at the Saloon.[/b]
[*][b]The Royal Candy recipe is available from the Travelling Merchant.[/b]
[*][b]Joja Candy can be discovered in the garbage can.[/b]
[/list]
